directions: Suppose your university is conducting a survey to collect students'opinions of online classes. You are to write a response to the survey about their advantages and disadvantages, and what improvements can be made. You will have 30 minutes for the task.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Online classes have become a prevalent mode of education, especially in recent times. To begin with, one significant advantage of online classes is their flexibility. Students can access course materials and lectures at any time and from anywhere, which is extremely convenient for those with busy schedules. For example, a student with a part-time job can study during their free hours. 

In addition, online classes often provide a wealth of resources. There are various learning materials such as e-books, videos, and interactive quizzes, which can enhance students' understanding of the courses. However, online classes also have their drawbacks. One major disadvantage is the lack of face-to-face interaction. Without in-person communication, students may feel isolated and have difficulty asking questions immediately. 

To improve online classes, universities could organize more virtual group discussions to increase interaction. Moreover, teachers should provide more timely feedback on students' assignments. In conclusion, while online classes have both pros and cons, with proper improvements, they can become an even more effective educational tool.
